Every dataset, ready to search

The tracker's full data layer, itemised. Filter by type or jurisdiction, search by keyword, download any table as CSV. Each row is the same data the charts read — nothing hidden, nothing simulated.

Ask the records anything

One searchable table of every record compiled from the retrieved data — 105 rows across seven datasets. Write your own queries, save the ones you reuse, and they become buttons below the bar.

Plain words work — "tax", "stablecoin", "unrest". Optional filters: country: · kind: · year: · dataset: · "exact phrase".

Match any variable to any variable

Pick a question; the page fits the relationship on the monthly panel (n = 45, Jan 2023 – Sep 2026) and tells you what it can and cannot claim. Everything runs in your browser on the same compiled data — no server, nothing hidden.

Compiled 9 Nov 2026. Sources are regulator statements reported through press coverage unless marked otherwise; known revisions are carried in the notes. CSV downloads include derivation flags where one exists. Saved queries persist in this browser.
